name: Abandon Colonial Claim
description: We shall compel our foes to renounce their unfounded claims on colonial domains, erasing their ambitions across the seas.

name: Abandon Colonies
description: Our enemies shall abandon their distant colonies, leaving them to ruin or to be claimed by others more worthy... like ourselves.

name: Abandon Piracy
description: The age of raiding and plunder is at an end. Our foes must swear to cease their acts of piracy and lawlessness upon the seas.

name: Assume Union Senority
description: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] is not fit to rule over the [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetDiplomacy.GetUnion.GetName]! We shall take over the burden of leadership, and assume the seniority over the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('union').GetName].

name: Block Foreign Buildings
description: No longer will foreign powers be allowed to build on our soil. Their ambitions shall wither under this treaty.

name: Break free from $tatar_yoke$
description: $break_the_yoke_desc$

name: Break away from Union
description: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] has gained too much influence within our court. They shall be ousted out of government, and the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('union').GetName] shall no longer dictate our fate.

name: Cancel Debt
description: Our debts shall be wiped clean, freeing us from the burdens of interest and financial servitude.

name: Union with [GetCountry('FRA').GetNameWithNoTooltip]
description: Through rightful blood and ancient precedent, we will assert dominion over the [GetCountry('FRA').GetLongName]. This treaty will pave the way for a new future for the entire region, under our rule.

name: Claim [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetNameWithFlag] Realm
description: By treaty and by right, we shall proclaim ourselves the heirs to the great legacy of [GetCharacter('chg_timur_lame_borjigin').GetShortName] and all that once bowed before it.

name: Claim [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName]
description: Claim the [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetFlavorRank] of [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] for the [COUNTRY.GetGovernment.GetRuler.GetDynasty] dynasty!

name: Crush the [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetAdjective] Revolt
description: Their upstrat revolt has been crushed. It is time now for the whip to put these rebels back in order!

name: Destroy the [target_ap.GetName]
description: Their patriarchate shall be dissolved by treaty, its hierarchy cast down and its members left to find a new spiritual lord.

name: Disband Kontor
description: We will demand that the Hanseatic Kontors are disbanded.

name: Dismantle Forts
description: Their walls and fortifications shall be torn down stone by stone, leaving them vulnerable to future judgment.

name: Dismantle the $hre$
description: The [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] itself shall be broken, its crown cast aside and its princes left to rule alone, free of imperial bonds.

name: Dissolve Coalition
description: This league of opportunists shall be scattered, its members cowed and divided, no longer united against us.

name: Dissolve Hanseatic League
description: The Hanseatic League has outlived its usefulness and is causing more harm than good with its influence in many European cities. All of the subjects under the League will be set free.

name: Dissolve League
description: Their league shall be no more, its cause shattered and its members forced to stand apart in peace. This will bring about a major shift in the power of balance during the [GetSituationByKey('italian_wars').GetName].

name: Dissolve $tatar_yoke$
description: $dissolve_the_yoke_desc$

name: Execute Ruler
description: They shall pay the ultimate price for defiance, executed by our decree so that all may know our power.

name: Expand Clan Influence
description: Our clan shall rise higher still, claiming new rights and lands at the expense of those who opposed us.

name: Force Convert [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetNameWithFlagWithNoTooltip] to [COUNTRY.GetReligion.GetNameWithNoTooltip]
description: The glory of our religion must be spread - even if it is done so by the blade!

name: Force Renounce to the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('ilkhanate').GetName] Claim
description: Our foes shall abandon all pretense of [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('ilkhanate').GetName] rule, renouncing the legacy they falsely claimed as their own.

name: Force Revolution
description: The old order shall be swept away. By this treaty we shall force them to embrace the fires of revolution.

name: Force [ShowSubjectTypeNameWithNoTooltip('tributary')]
description: $cb_make_tributary_desc$

name: Gain Clan Autonomy
description: We will establish ourselves as an independent domain, no longer will our territory be ruled by other clans.

name: Force Faction Change
description: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] changes their allegiance to [COUNTRY.Custom('GetGAGOwnFaction')], forcing them to join our cause.

name: $force_embargo$
description: We will enforce our demands as the Hegemon through military means.

name: $violate_sovereignty$
description: We will enforce our demands as the Hegemon through military means.

name: $force_change_court_language$
description: We will enforce our demands as the Hegemon through military means.

name: $force_divert_trade$
description: We will enforce our demands as the Hegemon through military means.

name: Overthrow High King
description: The leadership of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('high_kingship').GetName] must shift. No longer shall they claim dominion over the isle!

name: Humiliation
description: Through war and forceful means, we will assert our dominance against our rivals. Our superiority shall be clear and plain to see through this peace treaty.

name: Suppress [ShowReligionName('hussite')]
description: The heresy shall be put to the sword. By this treaty, we compel them to root out the [ShowReligionAdjective('hussite')] faith wherever it lingers.

name: Claim League Leadership
description: Through force of arms we have proven ourselves the dominant power in Italy. The leadership of their League now passes to us while their former leader is stripped of command by right of conquest.

name: Claim Confederation Leadership
description: It is time to take charge of our Confederation and lead it to greatness under our wise rule.

name: Force into our $jurchen_confederation$
description: They will fare better under our leadership!

name: Enforce League of the Public Weal
description: The princes shall have their victory, forcing the crown to bow and yield its power.

name: Crush League of the Public Weal
description: The king shall triumph, humbling the princes and restoring royal authority over the realm.

name: Leave the $hre$
description: The [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] shall no longer claim us as subject. Our lands shall stand apart from imperial law and protection.

name: Force Imperial Abdication
description: They shall be disbanded. Their people will be ordered to take refuge at the court of [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('japanese_shogunate').GetLeaderCountry.GetName].

name: Seize Opposition Leadership
description: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] is far too weak to stand up to the influence of [GetCountry('DLH').GetNameWithNoTooltip] during the [GetSituationByKey('fall_of_delhi').GetName] [situation|e]. Thus, it falls upon our shoulders to seize the opportunity and ensure the dissolution of yet another prospecting conqueror.

name: Punish Expedition's Foes
description: We shall punish them for interfering with our Treasure Voyage. They shall be held up as an example before the world, boosting our prestige as we heap disgrace on their names.

name: Recapture Emperor
description: The Emperor shall be freed and restored to his throne, and those who dared imprison him shall taste bitter shame.

name: Reinstate the Monarchy
description: The monarchy shall rise again, casting down the revolutionaries who sought to end the royal line.

name: Religious Supremacy
description: Enforce the superiority of our $religious_league_name$ within the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName]!

name: Revoke Clan Autonomy
description: Their autonomy of shall be stripped away, their fate once more brought under our control.

name: Rein in Rebellion
description: Rein in the rebels and force them to swear allegiance to us once again!

name: Demand Occupied Territories
description: Demand all [occupied|e] locations from the target [country|e].

name: Demand All Chinese Territories
description: Demand every [location|e] owned by the target [country|e] and their [subjects|e], including unoccupied territories.

name: Demand Complete Annexation
description: Only under one banner can $china$ return to peace! Fully annexes the target [country|e] and integrates all their territories — no occupation required.

name: Enforce Scaliger Demands
description: A set of hostile countries had the gall to oppose and shrink the domains of the [ShowDynastyName('scala_dynasty')]. It is time to cull the weak!

name: $MLO_ADJ$ Demands
description: A comprehensive set of demands in the $SCALIGER_WAR_NAME$ that are issued by the [GetCountry('MLO').GetLongName].

name: $FLO_ADJ$ Demands
description: All that is desired by the [GetCountry('FLO').GetLongName] in the $SCALIGER_WAR_NAME$.

name: $VEN_ADJ$ Demands
description: Our demands for the $SCALIGER_WAR_NAME$.

name: Demand Sound Toll Exemption
description: Our merchants shall pass freely through the [sound_toll], untaxed and unburdened by excess fees.

name: Take Maps
description: We shall take their knowledge of far away lands to use for our own gain.

name: Kidnap Pops
description: Their people shall resettle in our lands by force, strengthening our country while theirs grows weak.

name: Subjugate Natives
description: The natives shall bend the knee and accept our dominion, and their lands shall become ours by right.

name: Subjugate Neighbor Native
description: The Gods demand a ready supply of sacrifices wealth, which [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] will provide.

name: Take Mandate of Heaven
description: Take the leadership of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('middle_kingdom').GetName].

name: Take over [target_market.GetName]
description: The beating heart of their economy shall be ours, seized for the glory and profit of our country.

name: Take the Shogunate
description: Leadership within the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('japanese_shogunate').GetName] will pass into our hands. This will herald a new age as the destiny of [ShowRegionName('japan_region')] will henceforth be shaped by our rule.
